Spring trip: #travel and #trip/2026.

## Packing

Pack light: two pairs of trousers, three shirts, a rain jacket and the charger bundle. Keep the passport and the printed tickets in the front pocket of the carry-on, and put anything liquid in a clear bag before the airport check. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.

## Packing

Second pass on the bag the night before leaving: weigh it, remove one shirt if it is over the limit, and check that the power adapter and the spare memory card are inside. The colour of the tag is #ff8800 and the code sample `#notatag` is not a tag.

## Food

Book the dinner place near the harbour for the first night, and look for a bakery close to the hotel for breakfast. Check opening hours, because many small places close on Mondays and take their summer break early. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.

## Notes

Remember the umbrella.

## Budget

Set a daily budget for food, transport and tickets, keep the receipts in the shared folder, and compare the total with the plan when the trip is over so the next trip can be planned with better numbers. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.
